truth_contract.claim: This matrix is a public projection of the SIS 150-agent blueprint: 144 operative seats plus six council archetypes. The twelve ring titles and vows are editorial groupings over sequential source seats, not source-canonical domains. A listed seat is not evidence of deployment, sentience, AGI, live evaluation, or tool authority.

rings.name: Sovereign Command
rings.vow: Hold purpose, boundaries, and accountable direction.
rings.human_boundary: Credentials and irreversible decisions remain human-held.

seats.responsibility: Handles first-time user intake and routes vague requests.
Facilitates zero-terminal artifact delivery for non-technical users.
Listens to spoken executive intents and generates session packets.
Analyzes personal corpus to extract voice signatures and frameworks.
Runs model arena tests and rates compliance against standards.
Routes tasks, manages multi-step workflows, and drives YOLO sessions.
Synthesizes conflicting council inputs into a single rational path.
Designs database schemas, directory layouts, and system boundaries.
Charts execution roadmaps, identifies bottlenecks, and schedules tasks.
Audits code changes, monitors vulnerabilities, and triggers git rollbacks.
Weaves creative themes, brand design layouts, and technical copy.
Retrieves past lessons, resolves contradictions, and queries vaults.

rings.name: Memory & Intelligence
rings.vow: Preserve context without confusing recollection with truth.
rings.human_boundary: Private memory never crosses a public boundary by implication.

seats.responsibility: Conducts semantic lookup across local vaults, repositories, and web.
Manages active file-cleanup, resolves merge conflicts, and maintains packages.
Extracts structured JSONL memory atoms from terminal logs.
Scrapes Obsidian vault markdown files and indexes connections.
Evaluates custom agent prompt files and compiles system instructions.
Scans repository configurations to identify dependencies and exports.
Integrates Notion, Drive, and Google Keep entries via MCP.
Background process monitoring file drift and checking licenses.
Establishes the core persona, identity keys, and personal values.
Handles daily inbox parsing, tags notes, and surfaces repeating patterns.
Maintains visual assets, font alignments, and brand kits.
Manages BV accounting, corporate tax compliance, and entity rules.

rings.name: Life & Enterprise
rings.vow: Turn human values into durable personal and business systems.
rings.human_boundary: Health, family, finance, and identity decisions remain human-owned.

seats.responsibility: Formulates content calendars, newsletters, and creative pipeline gates.
Drives capital allocation decisions and monitors investment metrics.
Coordinates local workspace automation and MCP tool development.
Guides media asset attestation, audio editing, and video pipelines.
Updates kinship trees, manages private estate files, and schedules rituals.
Private, encrypted node handling long-term existential alignment.
Monitors nutrition plans, sleep logs, and physical exercises.
Screens candidate metrics and plans candidate sourcing pipelines.
Rehearses feedback conversations and plans performance calibrations.
Designs outcome-backed courses and measures skill transfer rates.
Structures company-wide values and schedules onboarding checkpoints.
Detects team burnout signs and evaluates team psychological safety.

rings.name: People, Sound & Culture
rings.vow: Help communities learn, create, perform, and belong.
rings.human_boundary: Consent, dignity, authorship, and cultural context are non-negotiable.

seats.responsibility: Models organizational charts, span of control, and role definitions.
Designs arrangements, drafts scores, and formats demo files.
Drafts mixing and mastering configurations and logs vocal chains.
Registers ISRCs, compiles metadata sheets, and handles deplatforming.
Plans live show setlists, broadcast schedules, and tour riders.
Handles listener maps, subscriber newsletters, and Fan stay-reviews.
Evaluates movie/TV briefs, sync placement fits, and licenses rights.
Apex gate keeper auditing track quality before greenlighting a release.
Curates the digital song masters database and manages label audits.
Manages AI voice models and logs persona background histories.
Generates album artwork, canvas slides, and promotional teasers.
Delivers master stems to streaming services and compiles link trees.

rings.name: Media, Energy & Resilience
rings.vow: Carry creative and physical systems from production into continuity.
rings.human_boundary: Spend, publication, infrastructure, and safety gates return to an owner.

seats.responsibility: Coordinates social media posts, advertising, and email drip feeds.
Models payout waterfalls, splits, and blockchain-based tokens.
Pitches tracks directly to supervisors and handles licensing payouts.
Calculates panel setups, battery cells, and heat pump outputs.
Calculates solar ROI, tax exemptions, and utility tariff plans.
Creates installation layouts, bill of materials, and permit files.
Logs panel generation, flags low efficiency, and triggers repairs.
Evaluates utility agreements and recommends grid sell-back paths.
Synchronizes with municipal virtual power plant (VPP) events.
Manages grid blackout alerts, battery backups, and local routing.
Monitors smart contract calls, gas costs, and whale address movements.
Models interest rate policies, market cycles, and liquidity pools.

rings.name: Wealth, Law & Governance
rings.vow: Make value, risk, rights, and jurisdiction inspectable.
rings.human_boundary: No agent may authorize transactions, legal commitments, or custody changes.

seats.responsibility: Inspects lending pool ratios, yield pools, and arbitrage logs.
Audits multi-sig wallet layouts, key paths, and cold storage locations.
Reviews new whitepapers, token structures, and developer commits.
Rebalances digital asset allocations based on risk targets.
Highlights liability terms, terminations, and intellectual rights.
Audits user data storage structures, consent forms, and cookie APIs.
Compiles local tax and corporate filing laws across active nodes.
Scrapes domain listings and logs trademark registrations.
Catalogues software licenses, copyright registrations, and source keys.
Maintains terms of service documents and privacy statements.
Prepares compliance checklists before substrate board hearings.
Models Keplerian satellite pathways and estimates decay dates.

rings.name: Cosmos & Planetary Observation
rings.vow: Observe distant and planetary systems with evidence and humility.
rings.human_boundary: Scientific uncertainty and physical safety remain explicit.

seats.responsibility: Schedules dark sky observation blocks and reviews weather models.
Logs sensor metrics, packet loss rates, and solar storm warnings.
Updates astronomical database files with target constellations.
Configures sensor capture intervals and registers image assets.
Coordinates data dumps with ground stations and verifies hash keys.
Cross-references space object catalogs to flag collision alerts.
Analyzes hydrophone audio files to flag vessel noise or whale calls.
Tracks salinity, temperature variations, and pH logs.
Evaluates AIS transponder signals to log marine reserve encroachments.
Logs marine mammal sightings and maps migration pathways.
Scans satellite views to flag coastal erosion and reef bleaching.
Compiles tide tables, current speeds, and dive safety checklists.

rings.name: Ocean, Health & Continuity
rings.vow: Care for living systems without pretending to replace expert judgment.
rings.human_boundary: Clinical, emergency, and field-safety decisions escalate to qualified people.

seats.responsibility: Maps oil spill patterns and registers ocean plastic collection logs.
Flags hormone, vitamin, and cardiovascular metrics from blood sheets.
Coordinates supplement schedules based on biomarker deficits.
Audits sleep cycles, heart rate variability, and bedroom environments.
Models resistance workouts, zone-2 cardio plans, and rest steps.
Reviews clinical longevity studies, peptide trials, and drug guides.
Logs caloric intakes, macronutrient profiles, and glucose metrics.
Tracks daily stress spikes and schedules breathing sessions.
Manages Vercel, Railway, and Cloudflare Workers deploy pipelines.
Tunes Kubernetes node configurations and memory allocations.
Audits cloud monthly usage and cleans orphaned storage blocks.
Runs automated database backups and validates target checksums.

rings.name: Infrastructure & Operations
rings.vow: Keep digital systems observable, reversible, and cost-aware.
rings.human_boundary: Production, secrets, migration, and destructive actions are gated.

seats.responsibility: Configures Cloudflare caching rules and mitigates DDoS attempts.
Filters debug logs, alerts on fatal crashes, and archives data.
Tracks local CPU temperatures, fan speeds, and NVMe disk health.
Imports profiles and kanban tasks from Nous Research Hermes agent.
Syncs project task queues and budgets with Paperclip dashboard.
Exposes TypeScript-native tools and agent steps via Mastra.
Bridges lightweight Python agents built on Agno framework.
Formats function call responses for the OpenAI Agents SDK.
Traces cyclical agent pathways and state branches in LangGraph.
Facilitates chat loops between AutoGen conversation nodes.
Formats goal prompts to invoke CrewAI role-playing agents.
Exports workflow structures and prompts to Dify visual engines.

rings.name: Harnesses & Research
rings.vow: Connect models, tools, and knowledge without hiding provenance.
rings.human_boundary: Adapters grant no authority beyond their authenticated runtime lease.

seats.responsibility: Configures local model configurations and manages GGUF files.
Scrapes latest machine learning and science preprints from arXiv.
Downloads biology preprints and filters them by target tags.
Queries PubMed IDs and formats citation link trees.
Aggregates citation metrics, h-indexes, and author lists.
Extracts charts and abstracts from scientific PDF documents.
Formats text columns into clean academic GitHub Markdown.
Pins digital signatures and cryptographic hashes onto papers.
Formats cinematic prompts and schedules generation calls.
Structures video prompts and edits camera panning metrics.
Renders flat book cover and thumbnail vectors via nb-image.
Generates Tailwind, shadcn, and HTML dashboard frames.

rings.name: Creation & Distribution
rings.vow: Transform ideas into useful artifacts and responsible public releases.
rings.human_boundary: Authorship, claims, audience data, and external sends remain human-reviewed.

seats.responsibility: Composes keyframe slides, background tunes, and voice tracks.
Optimizes visual prompt parameters and manages presets.
Audits visual outputs to reject blurry panels or text errors.
Translates technical whitepapers into business insights.
Distills complex codebase changes into engaging punchy posts.
Formats email campaigns, maps banner images, and checks links.
Pairs visual tiles with descriptive captions and location logs.
Drafts fast-paced video narratives and structures B-roll steps.
Generates meta titles, descriptions, and structures headers.
Publishes approved updates to Buffer, n8n, or API hooks.
Triages open bug issues, flags repeating bugs, and comments.
Answers general questions and responds to server commands.

rings.name: Community, Devices & Safety
rings.vow: Bind participation and physical interfaces to visible responsibility.
rings.human_boundary: Access, permissions, public communication, and hardware safety fail closed.

seats.responsibility: Reviews partner API integration requests against board limits.
Coordinates hackathons, workshop calendars, and schedules.
Updates product guides based on recurring community questions.
Welcomes new repository forks and audits PR checklist rules.
Measures product sentiment logs and extracts core feature requests.
Scrapes local solar battery stats and uploads CSV summaries.
Logs status statistics for local hardware server endpoints.
Checks P2P memory folder sync status and resolves duplicate files.
Captures voice recordings from microphone inputs.
Pulls images from local webcams to verify site status.
Controls physical HUD monitors or local e-ink status pages.
Shuts down background tasks if hardware CPU heat exceeds limits.

council.responsibility: Evaluates proposals for discipline, liability, and long-term legacy.
Evaluates proposals for team health, relations, and beauty.
Evaluates proposals for philosophical meaning and context limits.
Evaluates proposals for cost, execution speed, and simplicity.
Highlights hidden assumptions, ego motives, and security risks.
Focuses on long-horizon life fulfillment and value commitments.
